claim: Parallel workers in git worktrees see only committed work, and removing a worktree deletes its untracked files (two studies were lost so). git apply --3way stages what it applies. Workers that each append to the same plan tables conflict on both sides; one build writer per checkout.
use: Commit before branching workers; list and copy each worktree's untracked files before removal; commit merges with explicit paths; give parallel briefs a plan and a z band, since two clear branches can collide in height.
